scope: Surviving Kangra Fort ruins on the mapped ridge, with rampart runs, the northeastern stepped gate approach, the principal ruined court and representative temple foundations.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The archaeological inventory identifies the hill at the river confluence and standing Jaina and Brahmanical temple remains.
The Ministry of Tourism identifies multi-level battlements, successive gates and the major damage caused by the 1905 earthquake.
The Himachal Pradesh tourism department documents the fort’s rocky river relief and the separate entrance museum.

next: Model the stepped approach, the surviving principal ramparts along the ridge and the historical temple court as measured ruins. Preserve the actual ridge, make the pointed gate opening usable in the model, and document approximate wall tops and structure locations.
